welcome.title: Welcome to PearLift
welcome.description: Track your workouts with a simple interface. Log sets, reps, and weights - no complexity, just progress.

units.title: Choose units
units.description: Pick your preferred weight unit. You can change this later.

sync.title: Sync your devices
sync.description: Keep your workouts in sync across all your devices. No account needed — your data stays between your devices only.

notifications.title: Stay on Track
notifications.description: Enable notifications so you never forget a rest timer. We will remind you when its time to start your next set.

syncPrompt.title: Sync across your devices
syncPrompt.description: Your data never leaves your devices. You can set it up anytime in Settings.

setup.title: Set up device sync
setup.subtitle: Each device creates its own identity automatically. To pair devices, share the same Sync Code.
setup.shareHint: Share this Sync code (or QR) with your other device. That device must enter the same code to join your sync group.
setup.startSyncFirst: Press Start Sync first, then share this QR with your other device to join your sync group.
setup.scanHelp: Point your camera at the QR code on your other device.
setup.waitForConnection: Connection in progress. Scanner paused for stability.
setup.replaceJoinLabel: Replace my data with their data
setup.replaceJoinHint: Before first sync, this resets local workouts, exercise weights, and program configs on this device only.
setup.invalidCode: Invalid code. It must be 64 hex characters.

toast.newPeerMessage: A device joined the sync group.

description.issue: Sync needs attention. Open setup or diagnostics to resolve it.
description.connected: Your device is syncing with the group.
description.off: Sync is currently disabled on this device.

manage.title: Device sync
manage.subtitle: Keep group setup and sync maintenance in one place.
manage.roomSetupHint: Choose whether this device starts a new group or joins one that already exists.
manage.onboardingMessage: PearLift syncs your workouts directly between your devices — peer-to-peer. Your data never touches a server. All you need is to be on the same Wi‑Fi or nearby for the first connection.
manage.masterKeyHint: Use the same 64-character sync code on every device that should share data.
manage.masterKeyPlaceholder: Paste or edit the 64-character sync code
manage.leaveRoomConfirmMessage: This turns sync off, clears the current group binding on this device, and removes local group connection history.
manage.removeDeviceConfirmTitle: Remove this device from the list?
manage.removeDeviceConfirmMessage: This hides the device from this list on this device only. It can appear again if it syncs with this group later.

create.title: Create group
create.subtitle: This device starts a new sync group and can share the sync code with other devices.
create.explainer: Use this when this device should define the initial group and invite the others.
create.datasetSummary: This device currently has {{workouts}} workouts and {{exercises}} exercises.
create.inviteStarting: Starting group and generating the QR invite…
create.invitePending: Start the group to generate the QR invite.

join.title: Join group
join.subtitle: Use the sync code from another device to connect this device to the same sync group.
join.localSummary: This device currently has {{workouts}} workouts and {{exercises}} exercises.
join.remoteSummaryHint: If both devices already have a lot of overlapping changes, PearLift will ask which dataset to keep.
join.scanHelp: Point the camera at the QR code that contains the sync code.
join.invalidKey: Invalid sync code. It must be 64 hex characters.

decision.title: Choose first sync data
decision.subtitle: Both sides already contain meaningful data. Pick which baseline this group should keep.
decision.conflictSummary: {{workouts}} workout overlaps and {{exercises}} exercise overlaps were detected.
decision.configConflictSummary: {{weeks}} week config overlaps, {{days}} day config overlaps, {{backlog}} group updates waiting.
decision.useThisDeviceHint: This publishes this device as the group baseline.
decision.useRoomDataHint: This replaces workout data on this device while keeping app preferences.
decision.useMergeHint: Combine data from this device and the group when there are no overlaps.
decision.mergeUnavailableHint: Some workouts or exercises exist on both devices with different values, so merging isn't possible.

debug.title: Sync debug info
debug.subtitle: Runtime status, connection details, and recent sync logs.

day.deleteMessage: Delete "{{name}}"? This removes it from all weeks.

errors.setsInvalid: Sets must be a valid positive integer.

syncBackup.title: Sync & Backup
syncBackup.forgetConfirmMessage: This removes the pairing record locally. The device can still reconnect if it has the same sync code.

syncAdvanced.title: Sync Hub
syncAdvanced.description: Debug logs and device identifiers for troubleshooting.

data.title: Data
data.resetDescription: Permanently reset all workouts, settings, timer data, and sync history.

localJson.title: Local JSON
localJson.description: Export your workout data to a JSON file or import a previous backup.

importPreview.title: Import Preview
importPreview.noChanges: No changes detected. Backup is identical to current data.

deviceTransfer.shareDescription: On the other device, open Settings → Local Backup → Scan from another device.
deviceTransfer.shareChunkHint: Keep both devices steady. QR rotates automatically.
deviceTransfer.scanDescription: Point your camera at the PearLift backup QR code.
deviceTransfer.transferCorrupted: QR transfer failed integrity check. Please scan from the first chunk again.
deviceTransfer.cameraPermissionMessage: Allow camera access to scan a backup QR code.
deviceTransfer.cameraUnavailableMessage: PearLift could not access a usable back camera on this device.
deviceTransfer.invalidQr: That QR code doesn't look like a PearLift backup.
deviceTransfer.tooLarge: Backup is too large to fit in a single QR code. Use 'Save backup to device' instead.

resetAllData.title: Reset all data?
resetAllData.message: This will reset exercises, weights, weeks, days, timer settings, and all sync data (devices and sync code).
resetAllData.canceledMessage: System authentication did not confirm the reset.

pairNewDevice.title: Pair a new device?
pairNewDevice.message: This will show your Sync code and QR so another device can connect.
pairNewDevice.canceledMessage: System authentication did not confirm the action.

exportBackup.chooserMessage: Choose how you want to export your backup.
exportBackup.sharingUnavailableMessage: Sharing is not available on this device/platform.

forgetDevice.canceledMessage: System authentication did not confirm the action.
